priya (Product PM): Heads-up: working on long-term platform roadmap doc focused on routing policies + multi-region / tenant isolation. Need input on acceptance criteria and customer gradations. Quick brainstorm in thread? @jason @lucy

jason (Eng Lead): Yes. Suggest we define four customer tiers (trial, standard, premium, regulated) with explicit routing guarantees and clear migration paths between tiers.

lucy (Platform Eng): Prefer 3 tiers to keep config simpler, but we can support feature flags for regulated customers. Key axes: isolation level, allowed failover, model fallback policy, residency constraints.

priya (Product PM): OK — propose tiers: trial, production, regulated. Trial = shared, production = soft-dedicated, regulated = dedicated + residency. Need specific launch gates for each.

devan (SRE): Ops requirements: for regulated we must have documented evacuation playbook, capacity reservation, and audit trail for key actions. Production needs canary windows and automated rollback triggers. Trial can be best-effort with throttles.

jason (Eng Lead): Routing policy primitives we should include in spec: precedence order (customer override > tenant policy > global default), affinity hints (region/edge), model variant mappings, and fallback chains. Also include cost-aware fallback (e.g., quantized variant) with safety checks.

lucy (Platform Eng): I'll draft the policy DSL sketch. Example snippet for policy precedence:
```yaml
policy_precedence:
  - customer_override
  - tenant_bucket_policy
  - org_default
fallback_chain:
  - primary_model_v1
  - quantized_model_v1_q4
  - regional_compatible_model_v2
```

priya (Product PM): Good. For launch acceptance criteria, initial checklist (short): perf targets for three synthetic load profiles, telemetry hooks present in Console, regression alerts and eval pass, documented rollback/cutover steps, legal + compliance signoff for regulated.

devan (SRE): Add: fault injection/chaos test pass for cross-region failover, and an SLA burn-in period (30d) before removing extra monitoring. Also require a pre-cutover capacity test at 2x expected QPS for production/reg.

jason (Eng Lead): Technical notes: KV cache warming and batching behavior must be observable per-route. We need runtime knobs to limit batch size per tier and to force synchronous path if latency-critical (gaming use-cases).

lucy (Platform Eng): Agreed. Also will include quantization compatibility table per model family so routing can avoid incompatible fallbacks.

priya (Product PM): Customer asks to record up-front: bank requires strict residency + HSM, ad-platform needs burstable RTP (real-time pricing) <75ms, marketplace wants throughput SLAs. Will capture these as example templates in playbook.

devan (SRE): Ops caution: per-customer overrides increase blast radius. Include auto-eviction threshold and billing/commitment flag in tenant config.

infra-bot: created ticket PROD-1423 "routing-onramp-playbook" and assigned to @lucy

jason (Eng Lead): I'll align infra cost model to the three tiers and share tradeoff sheet by Fri.

lucy (Platform Eng): I'll push an initial spec PR with DSL + fallback matrix by EOW.

priya (Product PM): Thanks team. Plan: consolidate into a 1-pager for GTM by next Wednesday. Drop any existing prompt/eval sets or customer constraints here. :spiral_calendar:
